paper_title: SRPO Enhancing Multimodal LLM Reasoning via Reflection-Aware   Reinforcement Learning
caption_used: Accuracy comparison of six reinforcement learning configurations across three benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. Each benchmark displays grouped bars for DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (hatched blue), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (hatched orange), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (hatched green). In Mathverse, SRPO achieves the highest accuracy at approximately 56%, while DAPO+Self-reflection follows at roughly 55%, with the remaining methods clustered between 53% and 54%. Across MMLU, GRPO leads with approximately 57%, narrowly exceeding DAPO+Self-reflection, and PPO trails at about 54.5%. In the Physics benchmark, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches roughly 61%, with SRPO close behind at 60.5% and PPO at the lowest with approximately 57%. Notably, the self-reflection variants do not consistently outperform their base counterparts, as GRPO surpasses PPO+Self-reflection in both Mathverse and MMLU.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Линейна диаграма илюстрира сравнение на точността на шест конфигурации за подсилващо обучение в рамките на три бенчмарка: Mathverse, MMLU и Physics. Хоризонталната ос представя трите бенчмарка, разположени в този ред, а вертикалната ос е обозначена като "Accuracy (%)" и показва стойности, вариращи от 50% до 62%, с линейна скала и стъпка от 1. За всеки бенчмарк има групирани стълбове, представящи шестте конфигурации: DAPO+Self-reflection (пълни сини стълбове), DAPO (шарени сини стълбове), SRPO (пълни оранжеви стълбове), GRPO (шарени оранжеви стълбове), PPO+Self-reflection (пълни зелени стълбове) и PPO (шарени зелени стълбове). В бенчмарка Mathverse, SRPO показва най-висока точност при приблизително 56%, следван от DAPO+Self-reflection с приблизително 55%, като останалите методи са групирани между 53% и 54%. В бенчмарка MMLU, GRPO води с приблизително 57%, леко надвишавайки DAPO+Self-reflection, а PPO има приблизително 54.5%. В бенчмарка Physics, DAPO+Self-reflection достига приблизително 61%, SRPO е близо с 60.5%, а PPO е с най-ниската стойност от приблизително 57%. Наблюдават се визуални разлики във височината на стълбовете между конфигурациите за всеки бенчмарк.
model_annotations.Chinese: 此图表展示了六种强化学习配置在三个基准上的准确度比较：Mathverse、MMLU 和 Physics。 水平轴表示基准，显示 Mathverse、MMLU 和 Physics 三个类别。 垂直轴表示 Accuracy，其标签为“Accuracy (%)”，从 50 到 62 范围内的刻度为线性，刻度间隔为 2。 每个基准都显示了分组的条形图，分别对应 DAPO+Self-reflection（实心蓝色）、DAPO（点状蓝色）、SRPO（实心橙色）、GRPO（点状橙色）、PPO+Self-reflection（实心绿色）和 PPO（点状绿色）。在 Mathverse 中，SRPO 达到最高的准确度，约为 56%，DAPO+Self-reflection 随之而来，约为 55%，而其余方法在 53% 到 54% 之间集聚。在 MMLU 中，GRPO 领先，约为 57%，略好于 DAPO+Self-reflection，而 PPO 的准确度约为 54.5%。在 Physics 基准中，DAPO+Self-reflection 达到约为 61%，SRPO 紧随其后，约为 60.5%，而 PPO 的准确度最低，约为 57%。 条形图按基准分组，每个基准内表示各自配置的各个条形。 所有条形图都未进行视觉强调。
model_annotations.English: This chart illustrates a comparison of accuracy percentages for six reinforcement learning configurations across three benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis represents the benchmarks, listed in the order Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and displays values on a linear scale ranging from 50 to 62, with tick labels at intervals of 2. Each benchmark features a group of six bars, representing DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (hatched blue), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (hatched orange), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (hatched green). For the Mathverse benchmark, the shortest bars represent PPO and PPO+Self-reflection, both reaching approximately 53%, while the tallest bar, representing SRPO, extends to approximately 56%. Across MMLU, the bars range from approximately 54.5% (PPO) to 57% (GRPO). Finally, for the Physics benchmark, the bars range from approximately 57% (PPO) to approximately 61% (DAPO+Self-reflection). The bars are arranged in groups associated with each benchmark, and no specific bars are visually emphasized beyond their color and hatching patterns.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm vergleicht die Genauigkeit von sechs Reinforcement-Learning-Konfigurationen über drei Benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU und Physics. Auf der horizontalen Achse sind die drei Benchmarks dargestellt, und auf der vertikalen Achse ist die Genauigkeit in Prozent mit einem linearen Skalenbereich von 50 bis 62 dargestellt, wobei die Tick-Beschriftung jedes 2% erfolgt. Jedes Benchmark enthält sechs Balkengruppen, die jeweils eine Reinforcement-Learning-Konfiguration darstellen: DAPO+Self-reflection (Massivblau), DAPO (gestrichelt blau), SRPO (Massivorange), GRPO (gestrichelt orange), PPO+Self-reflection (Massivgrün) und PPO (gestrichelt grün). Für Mathverse liegt der höchste Balken bei SRPO mit etwa 56%, gefolgt von DAPO+Self-reflection mit ungefähr 55%; die restlichen Balken liegen zwischen ungefähr 53% und 54%. Für MMLU führt GRPO mit etwa 57%, knapp vor DAPO+Self-reflection, wobei PPO ungefähr 54,5% erreicht. In Physics erreicht DAPO+Self-reflection ungefähr 61%, mit SRPO knapp dahinter bei 60,5% und PPO mit ungefähr 57%. Die höherwertigen Balken sind alle orangefarben, während die niedrigerwertigen Balken alle grün sind. Die Balkengruppen sind innerhalb jedes Benchmarks nebeneinander angeordnet, und es werden keine besonderen visuellen Hervorhebungen verwendet, um bestimmte Balken hervorzuheben.
